protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

source.description: AI-assisted regional adaptation of the complete English benchmark fixture, aligned paragraph by paragraph with the approved German translation and written for Austrian Standard German narration; no independent human or pronunciation review has been performed.

support.scope: Pinned Austrian Standard German checkpoint, synthetic M2 speaker, Austrian phonetic rules and accent conditioning.
support.notes: The model card/demo expose two synthetic speakers (F2, M2); internal label AT is the Austrian accent style, not a third public speaker. Benchmark settings use M2 at internal index 1, speed 1.0, pitch shift 0, pitch range 1.0, accent 1.0, 24 kHz and INT8 Vocos. Austrian pronunciation readings are enabled at accent >= 0.5. The upstream card describes an early-preview mild/inconsistent Austrian Standard German accent, not a dialect; output rights are not inferred from the model license.

settings.gapPolicy: 120 ms between sentence/clause segments; fixed fixture chunk boundaries add no gap
settings.frontend: Pinned Apptor German frontend and Austrian dictionary/rules; Austrian readings enabled at accent >= 0.5

capability.description: Explicit single-thread WASM inference for Austrian G2P, TTS and Vocos.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
Raw WAV is saved locally; opt-in audio publication is separate from timing and automatic result submission.
